reason: This transaction requires human review because two anomalies were found: a missing purchase order (PO-1005) referenced by both the invoice and receipt but absent from the case file, and a date inconsistency where the receipt (2026-07-18) is dated three days before the invoice (2026-07-21). The missing PO issue, at medium severity and 0.85 confidence, is the primary driver of this decision.

findings.explanation: PO-1005 is explicitly referenced by both INV-1005 and REC-1005 but no purchase order document exists in the case file, so the transaction's authorization cannot be verified.
The receipt REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice date of 2026-07-21, an unexplained chronological inversion between acceptance and invoicing.
